scope: E002 only: native press/release input, Teleop parameters and targets, entry wiring, README/interfaces; preserve model and LQR/VMC

acceptance.release: W/S release requests zero and brakes actual body to <0.05m/s after settling; focus loss also clears
acceptance.direction: W gives negative model X (user-defined robot forward), S positive
acceptance.speed: requested speed ±1.2 m/s = three times previous ±0.4
acceptance.leg: continuous 0.12m/s target adjustment, release holds, expanded 0.18..0.34 if physical validation passes
acceptance.jump: increase motor-only jump rise beyond previous 0.127m; stable landing; no torque-limit changes
acceptance.desktop: actual press/hold/release events, not only callback injection
